evidence.note: Design review verified via offline character/line simulation (Antigravity 11,485 chars, Claude 125 lines, Codex 125 lines). No mutating changes applied to runtime or master files.

body.current_gaps: Budget-saving and compute governance rules are currently fragmented across core.md (P0 classification, P3 concurrency, P4 retry limits, P6 algorithmic efficiency, P7 cache stability) and routes/model-and-reasoning-routing.md without a single auditable policy. Crucial safety guardrails for local engine fallback (e.g., Ollama eligibility and prohibitions against auth/deployment/destructive authority) are missing from global rules. Platform adapters lacked explicit execution boundaries regarding active turn switching and environment selection. Previous reporting prematurely claimed 'optimized low-cost operation' while A/B telemetry was UNMEASURED, and claimed '3-party consensus' while Claude Code was dormant without an independent vote.
proposed_paths: shared/global-rules/core.md (clean deduplication in P0 and P7)
shared/global-rules/adapters/antigravity.md (explicit next turn/headless and IDE-vs-CLI execution boundary)
body.canonical_section_draft:
## Token and compute budget governance

- Safety and quality floors are non-negotiable: cost or quota pressure never lowers thresholds for security, authentication, deployment, destructive actions, or external effects; use an equivalent tier or `BLOCKED`.
- Single-agent execution is default; spawn subagents or parallelize only for independent tasks with material benefit. Load minimal context, tools, and rules. Stop retrying after three failures for the same cause.
- Route future launches only; never claim an active turn switched. Classify observable risk, scope, ambiguity, reversibility, and verification; choose the least costly model and effort meeting the quality floor. Escalate one tier once after explicit failure.
- Route low-risk, bounded, non-secret, locally verifiable tasks or quota fallbacks to eligible local engines (such as Ollama) or equivalent tiers. Never grant local or fallback engines authority over authentication, deployment, destructive actions, or unverified final decisions. Versioned scoped policy holds model names, prices, quotas, and CLI syntax.
- Preserve prompt and rule stability to reduce unnecessary prompt cache invalidation. Verify launch availability; record requested and actual model, effort, reason codes, outcome, and per-provider usage.
- Treat telemetry and savings as `UNMEASURED` until validated by preregistered A/B evaluation. Roll out only task types passing safety and quality gates.

per_platform_adapter_deltas.antigravity: Route only the next turn or a new headless run; select IDE vs CLI by interactive visibility versus automation need. Never claim an active turn switched. Retain GEMINI.md loader, <12,000 char limit, procedures in skills, and Deny > Ask > Allow with Ask for browser/non-workspace.
per_platform_adapter_deltas.claude_code: Apply routing only to a new bounded session or subagent with supported controls; use opusplan only for a real plan-to-execution split. Never claim an active turn switched. Retain CLAUDE.md loader, loading order, and connector isolation.
per_platform_adapter_deltas.codex: Apply routing only when creating a new task, subagent, or CLI run through supported model and reasoning controls. Never claim an active turn switched; preserve existing selection when no route is requested. Retain AGENTS.md loader, override precedence, and deterministic sandbox/hooks.

deduplication_map.P0_authority: Removed redundant rule/tool loading mention ('Load only relevant rules and tools') in P0; fully consolidated in Budget Governance ('Load minimal context, tools, and rules').
deduplication_map.P3_concurrency: Retained thread-safe write serialization/read parallelization in P3; consolidated subagent/multi-agent parallelization cost limits in Budget Governance.
deduplication_map.P4_verification: Retained three-failure diagnostic stop in P4 for execution semantics; capped retry count in Budget Governance.
deduplication_map.P7_reporting: Extracted prompt cache stability rule from P7 into Budget Governance; P7 now strictly focuses on completion reporting and isolating machine-readable continuity payloads.
deduplication_map.standalone_routing_removal: routes/model-and-reasoning-routing.md is fully retired and superseded by routes/token-and-compute-budget.md.

safety_preservation_matrix.P0_precedence: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Platform precedence, user override, skill boundary, conflict resolution, device independence, visible failure diagnosis).
safety_preservation_matrix.P1_language_format: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Natural Korean for user, English technical terms in parentheses only when helpful, outcome-led direct responses, explain what/why/next action, single high-value question).
safety_preservation_matrix.P2_auth_safety: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Full secret blocklist, zero secret leakage, explicit approval for destructive/payment/deploy actions, mock/sandbox first, MCP install approval, unbreakable policy boundary).
safety_preservation_matrix.P3_state_ownership: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Baseline inspection, non-owned change preservation, write serialization, canonical artifact regeneration, physical directory workspace audit).
safety_preservation_matrix.P4_verification: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Public interfaces preservation, mandatory exit 0, amount/currency/rate/date verification, 3x stop rule, goal-to-verification tracking).
safety_preservation_matrix.P5_organization: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Section self-containment, root reservation, git mv canonical tracking, link mapping, untracked/ignored audit).
safety_preservation_matrix.P6_quality: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Maintainability, existing convention preservation, algorithmic complexity inspection, single documentation system).
safety_preservation_matrix.P7_reporting: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Fact vs inference separation, lead with results, compact result capsule for nontrivial completions/failures/mutations/decisions, failure alternatives, visual header audit).
safety_preservation_matrix.budget_safety_floor: PRESERVED_100_PCT (Security/auth/deployment/destructive actions strictly immune to cost downgrades; local Ollama engines strictly barred from auth/deploy/destructive authority).

tests_to_add: Negative test verifying that routing security-critical tasks (e.g. auth, deploy, destructive actions) to local Ollama or sub-floor models is rejected with BLOCKED / exit 1.

Single-heading validation in sync-global-rules.ps1 ensuring exactly one '## Token and compute budget governance' heading exists and zero '## Deterministic model and reasoning routing' headings exist across all generated targets.
Capacity test in SourceCheck enforcing Antigravity characters <= 11,600.
Adapter execution boundary test ensuring every adapter explicitly prohibits claiming an active turn switched.
unresolved_risks: Claude Code weekly quota remains exhausted until 2026-09-12T05:00:00+09:00 KST, precluding true 3-way live cross-tool behavioral consensus.
Local Ollama engine performance and reasoning latency on Windows workstations are unbenchmarked under production load.
All cost savings remain strictly UNMEASURED pending preregistered A/B pilot telemetry with explicit user budget authorization.
